caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a wooden tool with a round, flat head attached to a cylindrical handle. The handle is vertical, with a natural wood color and visible grain patterns. The head of the tool is circular and features carved decorative elements: an inner circle with an eight-pointed star pattern and an outer ring outlined with evenly spaced triangular notches. The tool's coloration is primarily light brown, with slight shading to indicate depth and texture. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. In the lower right corner, the name “FRANK H. GRAY.” is written, and near the top right corner, the word “mat” is faintly visible.
title: Wooden Butter Stamp
